name: Global MOLA coarse numerical terrain
acquired: Supplied original; original acquisition date not recorded
processing: Rasterio average resampling to 0.25 degree cells. Periodic longitude centred differences and latitude finite differences using Mars surface spacing. Edge latitude derivatives one-sided. All elevation and slope metrics use this derived grid, not native 463 m cells.
limitations: Approximately 14.8 km north-south; east-west spacing varies with latitude.
Cell-average elevations hide local slopes and obstacles.
Global exploration context, not EVA navigation.
Source interpolation and physical elevation uncertainty are not quantified here.
